name: Strategy& (PwC)
one_liner: PwC's strategy consulting business, formerly Booz & Company, known for capabilities-driven strategy and cost transformation work.
at_a_glance: Traces roots to Booz (founded 1914); PwC acquired Booz & Company in 2014.
Roughly 4,500+ consultants globally, part of PwC's network.
Known for capabilities-driven strategy and 'Fit for Growth' cost transformation.
Linked to strategy+business, PwC's management publication.

rounds: US MBA recruiting: one round of about three virtual interviews, each with case and behavioral parts.
Offer decisions typically within a few weeks of interviews.
interview_process.case_style: Candidate-led, strategy-oriented cases (growth, M&A, market entry); some offices may use a written or presentation case.
interview_process.fit_style: Behavioral questions in each interview; candidates are told to prepare using the PwC Professional framework.
interview_process.assessments: None standard for US MBA roles as far as public sources show.

what_they_look_for: Leadership of workstreams and team priorities
Willingness to speak up and challenge conventional thinking
culture: Culture emphasizes speaking up and challenging conventional thinking.
Strategy work connected to PwC's broader transformation and technology capabilities.
why_us_angles: How does capabilities-driven strategy match what you've seen in your own work?
Why does linking strategy to PwC's execution and tech teams matter to you?
What have you learned from Strategy& consultants about their day-to-day work?
prep_tips: Since there is one round, bring your best case and fit performance from the first interview.
Map your stories to the PwC Professional framework dimensions.
Practice strategy cases (growth, M&A) alongside cost cases.
Prepare a clear answer on why Strategy& and not only MBB.
